opb. Surgical treatment is indicated in asymptomatic patients when there is left ventricular dysfunction (left ventricular ejection fraction <60% and / or left ventricular end-systolic diameter> 40 mm).
opc. Surgical treatment is indicated in symptomatic patients, especially above a 30% left ventricular ejection fraction.
opd. Mitral valve repair has a surgical risk superior to mitral valve replacement surgery.
